the proposed Kalman Filter signal tracking system is able to track the state of simulated jammer signals at the output of an RF front end.
the proposed TDOAs and Kalman Filter signal tracking methods are feasible, and that they can provide reasonable jammer geolocation results on real data from our TDOA campaign.

the simulation, tracking, and geolocation of chirp type civilian GPS jammers.
the tracking of a simulated jammer signal using a Kalman Filter and the geolocation of a real jammer signal using TDOA measurements.
the tracking of GPS jammer signals and the geolocation of jammers using the TDOA method.

a TDOA system is capable of geolocating a jammer in real time with a precision of 10 meters or better.

the Kalman Filter based TDOA jamming system is capable of estimating jammer locations with a precision comparable to that of INS systems, while requiring only the measurement of the jammer signal at each TDOA station.
